title: Pedestrian crossing signal controller (timed phases)
nl_spec: Control a road signal with a pedestrian crossing using a timed state machine with three states: 0 = cars green, 1 = cars yellow, 2 = cars red / pedestrian walk. In state 0 the car signal is green and the pedestrian sign shows don't-walk; the controller leaves green only after a minimum green time (PT_GREEN = 3 ticks) AND a pedestrian request (PedReq) is present, moving to yellow. Yellow lasts PT_YELLOW = 2 ticks, then to the walk phase. The walk phase (cars red, pedestrian walk) lasts PT_WALK = 3 ticks, then back to green. Use an internal INT State (0..2) and one TON timer per phase. SAFETY-CRITICAL: cars must never have green while pedestrians have walk, and only one car aspect may be lit at a time. Write an IEC 61131-3 Structured Text PROGRAM named ped_crossing with input PedReq and outputs CarGreen, CarYellow, CarRed, PedWalk.

safety_properties.nl: Cars never have green while pedestrians have walk.
Pedestrian walk is only shown while the car signal is red.
Car green and car yellow are never lit together.
Car green and car red are never lit together.

scenarios.description: Full cycle with a standing pedestrian request

notes: Three TON timers (one per phase) gated by state at top level. Minimum-green plus pedestrian-request gating before leaving green.
